title: Talk, share and set up faster
summary: Dictate with your voice, share work with your organization, and set up AI without the guesswork.

highlights.title: Dictate with your voice
highlights.body: Record a message instead of typing it. A live waveform shows that Matrix is listening, in the browser and in the desktop app.

highlights.title: Share with your organization
highlights.body: Share projects, chats, files, folders and apps with people in your organization from every OS view. Your organization also gets a shared drive.

items.text: Setting up Matrix AI and your coding agents takes fewer steps.
Settings shows which agents you saved separately from whether they are ready.
Chats show what delegated agents are doing.
Files and artifacts an agent creates appear in the chat with previews.
Markdown files preview in chat, and your own messages render formatting.
Project menus can show the project in Files.
Terminals keep a scrollable history pinned beside the live view.
An Inbox Triage agent can sort your Gmail inbox.
New users are offered the desktop app first during setup.
The unread filter in Chat takes less space.
Custom app icons load faster.
Approval requests show safe details and your decision.
The model picker refreshes its list when you open it.
Terminal grids fill the window, including in full screen.
Terminal scrolling keeps following new output and remembers where you navigated.
Agent logos show correctly in the desktop app.
Chat shows Claude versions and keeps the Claude CLI up to date.
Agents you turned off stay off in Chat and in the model picker.
Tools found on custom MCP servers are turned on by default.
Connecting an app finishes even if the browser session ended.
Settings shows Pi and OpenCode accounts the agent manages itself.
Tool commands and results stay in the chat history.
Links in Claude replies stay intact while the reply streams.
If a payment fails, you're taken to billing to sort it out.
